hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */services/scraper/*.py) r="${f%%/services/scraper/*}/services/scraper/.venv/bin/ruff"; [ -x "$r" ] && "$r" format "$f" && "$r" check --fix "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */services/web/frontend/*.ts|*/services/web/frontend/*.tsx) d="${f%%/services/web/*}/services/web/frontend";; */services/web/*.ts|*/services/web/*.tsx) d="${f%%/services/web/*}/services/web";; *) exit 0;; esac; b="$d/node_modules/.bin/eslint"; [ -x "$b" ] && cd "$d" && "$b" --fix "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true

hooks.statusMessage: bases de test que gatean la integración
